svg.title: Self-Diagnosing Agent architecture
svg.desc: A four-layer loop where an agent forms a belief before a tool call, simulates the outcome, diagnoses observed-versus-expected discrepancy, then classifies whether the fault is world drift or its own hallucination.

g.text: Predict tool effect + split confidence: task vs effect
Write mini shadow-impl, simulate outcome before commit
Compare observed vs belief + shadow; classify drift type
ToolScan 7 patterns · MACI post-check · functional hallucination
Does this belief contradict other held beliefs?

svg.text: Layer 4 splits every discrepancy into two actions — the core novelty
no MCP paper closes this loop; existing work stops at external effect scoring
